svg.text: SCHEMATIC SHEET 1/1 • LEXICON DUAL-RF USB RADIO DONGLE (REV 2.0 RETAIL - 1× USB-C / 2× SMA)
1. POWER MANAGEMENT & 3× ULTRA-LOW-NOISE RF LDO ISOLATION
Separate LDOs U5 & U6 + BLM18PG121 beads prevent TX PA droop coupling.
2. SINGLE RETAIL USB-C NATIVE INTERFACE, ESD & CONTROLS
• Eliminates external UART bridge IC & 2nd USB-C port from dev kits
• Native ESP32-S3 USB PHY provides simultaneous High-Speed CDC-ACM
64KB packet stream + hardware JTAG debug + automatic DFU flashing
TACTILE BUTTONS (C&K PTS636) & ADDRESSABLE RGB TELEMETRY LED
• SW1 (RST): CHIP_PU/EN + R5 (10kΩ Pull-Up) + C9 (100nF RC)
• SW2 (BOOT): GPIO0 + R6 (10kΩ) + C10 (100nF Hardware Debounce)
• SW3 (MODE): GPIO47 + R7 (10kΩ Pull-Up) — Validator / Repeater Toggle
• D5 (LED): WS2812B-2020 (GPIO48) — Synced / TX Burst / LBT
All switch inputs include 100nF hardware debounce MLCCs (0402 X7R).
FSPI (SPI2) 20 MHz DMA BUS → RADIO 0 (U2 LR2021)
HSPI (SPI3) 20 MHz DMA BUS → RADIO 1 (U3 LR2021)
• Core 0: USB-C CDC / Wi-Fi TCP + 65,024B Option-C Ring
• Core 1: Parallel SPI2 (RF0) & SPI3 (RF1) ISR Engine
3. SHIELD SH1: RADIO 0 (U2 LR2021 • SUB-GHz & 2.4GHz) → DEDICATED J2 ANT0 SMA
4. SHIELD SH2: RADIO 1 (U3 LR2021 • SUB-GHz & 2.4GHz) → DEDICATED J3 ANT1 SMA
TITLE: LEXICON DUAL-RF USB RADIO DONGLE (RETAIL REV 2.0)
DESIGN ID: LEX-DRF-PCBA-R2.0 • 1× USB-C + 2× SMA ANTENNA PORTS
ISOLATION: >55 dB Dual Shield Cans + Independent J2/J3 SMA Feeds
